title: Logos 5 opening: Father does not preexist the Son
english: Fifth discourse. That the Father does not preexist the Son, even if he is unbegotten; he was co-eternal with him.
Unbegotten must not be twisted into “earlier.” Father and Son are together without a when in which the Father alone was.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
After Logos I rem; earliest-forward Logos 5.
